ITEM 1 | Sliced reddish-brown cured sausage rounds with glossy, slightly oily sheen and browned edges, cut into diagonal-to-round pieces about 1.5 cm thick and 3-4 cm long, arranged in a cluster on the left side of the plate, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Thin strips of crispy, dark reddish-brown pan-fried meat with browned, slightly charred edges and a glossy surface, lying flat in overlapping curled slices about 0.2 cm thick, sitting behind and beside the sausage on the upper-left area of the plate, covering roughly 10% of the plate | 45
ITEM 3 | Soft, pale yellow scrambled eggs in irregular moist clumps and curds with a slightly glossy surface, mounded about 2 cm high, sitting in the lower-center of the plate and covering roughly 22% of the plate | 120
ITEM 4 | Bright green broccoli florets with dark green tips and firm stems, slightly glossy from cooking, clustered on the right side of the plate in a mound about 2-3 cm high, covering roughly 12% of the plate | 70
ITEM 5 | Stir-fried dark green leafy vegetables (spinach-like leaves) mixed with thin orange carrot shreds and pale green stalk pieces, glistening with light moisture or oil, piled about 1.5 cm high on the upper-right of the plate, covering roughly 12% of the plate | 55
